title: Ventriloquy
summary: VENTRIL'OQUY, noun [Latin venter, belly, and loquor, to speak.] The act, art or practice of speaking in such a manner that the voice appears to come not from the person, but from some distant place, a

inlines.v: VENTRIL'OQUY, noun [Latin venter, belly, and loquor, to speak.] The act, art or practice of speaking in such a manner that the voice appears to come not from the person, but from some distant place, as from the opposite side of the room, from the cellar, etc.
